trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies. The platinum unlocks automatically once every other trophy is yours — there is no extra task. Use the checklist here and the roadmap stages to track what is left.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game and cannot be missed — just play through the opening until the mission completes.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 by playing its missions in order. Story trophies unlock automatically as you progress; there is nothing extra to do.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Keep playing the story missions in order and the trophy unlocks at the chapter's end.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. As with the other chapter trophies, it unlocks automatically when the chapter's final mission is done.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale; keep following the story markers.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. Before starting it, finish any stranger strands and side activities you care about, in case the post-game changes what is available.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.missableNote: No source confirms a point of no return for this mission; it unlocks through the story.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks through normal story progress — follow the mission markers when it appears.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.missableNote: No source confirms a point of no return for this mission; it unlocks through the story.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is a story heist — play it when the story offers it and the trophy follows.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.missableNote: No source confirms a point of no return for this mission; it unlocks through the story.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It unlocks through the story; there is no optional step to it.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.missableNote: No source confirms a point of no return for this mission; it unlocks through the story.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It unlocks through the story; play it when it appears on the map.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.missableNote: No source confirms a point of no return for this mission; it unlocks through the story.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. A story heist at the airport — follow the mission markers when it unlocks.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.missableNote: No source confirms a point of no return for this mission; it unlocks through the story.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks through the story; finish it when the mission becomes available.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. That means finishing the story, all stranger strands, every activity and collectible the checklist tracks, and the counts this guide lists. Save this for last — it is the final gold before the platinum.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, long air time and near-misses all count — the counter tracks them across the whole game, so keep driving fast and jumping ramps as you play.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type at least once: races, the shooting range, fishing, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and more. One attempt each is enough — you do not need to win or finish them.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge. Practice each weapon's challenge until the gold threshold is met; the range shows your best medal per challenge so you can see what is left.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Find each drone race start around Leonida and win it once — the map marks them after you discover them.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Each distinct race counts once, so spread your wins across street, off-road and water races rather than repeating one.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Meet Cal at a fishing spot and out-fish him — watch the tension meter and reel steadily instead of yanking.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Walk into any arcade in Leonida, start a cabinet game and play it through to its end — any game counts.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missableNote: Sources disagree on whether this strand locks after the finale; finish it before the final mission to be safe.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Finish Andy's strand before the final story mission, since guides disagree on whether it stays available afterwards.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missableNote: Sources disagree on whether this strand locks after the finale; finish it before the final mission to be safe.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Clear Kenton's strand before the finale to be safe — the sources disagree on post-game availability.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missableNote: Sources disagree on whether this strand locks after the finale; finish it before the final mission to be safe.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's strand before the final mission; guides disagree on whether it remains open afterwards.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: Start stranger strands when they appear; a few are tied to story progress, so do not rush the finale before finishing them.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Strangers appear as markers on the map as the story advances — start each strand when it appears and work through its missions.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missableNote: Sources disagree on whether this strand locks after the finale; finish it before the final mission to be safe.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's strand before the finale — guides disagree on whether it stays available after the story ends.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand runs through the story — finish its last mission when it appears.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: Meditation spots are spread across Leonida; do them as you find them — no source confirms whether any spot locks after the story, so do not leave them all to the end.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. Meditation spots are quiet viewpoints marked on the map — sit and meditate at each one. Do them as you find them rather than saving them all for after the story.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret marks a rare animal's territory — track it, get close without spooking it, and take the shot cleanly.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida in shops, houses and landmarks — collect every card in three full sets; the collection screen shows which sets are missing cards.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK spots are marked across Leonida — visit each one and use the WAiNK interaction. The counter in the collection screen shows how many you have done.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges cover stunts, races, shooting, hunting and more — the challenges menu tracks your total, so work through the easiest ones first.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build up to 4 stars together, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the wanted level clears.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Chain three shop robberies in a row while keeping the same wanted level — plan a route between nearby shops and move fast.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every distinct vehicle you drive counts once — the vehicle list in the app shows what you have found. Try new cars, bikes, boats and aircraft as you come across them.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus in a firefight with at least five enemies nearby, then chain the kills before the focus meter runs out.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). Steal a plane at the airport and take off without following the usual departure — the trophy pops once you are airborne.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank and cause mayhem — the trophy's description hints at the heat. Steal a Rhino from a military area and drive it through the city.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store, enter quietly, grab the goods and leave before the alarm or cameras spot you — a stealthy approach beats a loud one.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Each bank vault robbery needs a plan and a getaway — complete five of them and get clear of the police each time.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, break it open, take the cash and lose the police — a fast getaway car helps.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Drive, fly and walk through every region of the map until the exploration counter is complete — the map fills in as you visit new areas.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang. Every gang runs hidden operations around Leonida — find and rob one per gang.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view — the trophy pops once the scene plays.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a showroom's glass front — the classic GTA way out — and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Play a full game of bowling there and finish it — the trophy follows the game, not the score.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Build a partnership with mass appeal. This is tied to a side activity with a partner — keep doing partnered activities until the partnership reaches its peak.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make a choice (for better or worse). At a story decision point, pick either option — the trophy is about making the choice, not which one you pick.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Try again after a failure — second time's the charm. Fail a specific activity or mission once, then succeed on the retry and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Trigger a strange encounter — what the hell just happened? This is an easter egg moment in Leonida; explore unusual places and the trophy finds you.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl enemies over with a melee drive-by. Swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and knock down targets — a drive-by with a bat or similar weapon counts.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — pass them to your contacts to clean them, and the total counts toward $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, food and more — every shop purchase counts toward the total, so spend as you play.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Garages are for sale across Leonida — buy every one. The property menu shows which garages you still need.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find ten different vehicles, open the Scooter Bros app and register each one — the app tracks how many you have registered.
